title: Skill Buff: Auditions, Agents, and Building a Career in Game Performance
prompt: Build a game voice acting audition simulator. A script line appears with an emotional direction tag (Weary Veteran, Cocky Rogue, Terrified Civilian); the player types their interpretation of the delivery note into a text box, then clicks 'Perform' and an animated character delivers a procedurally-varied version of the line. The casting director NPC scores each take on Clarity, Emotion, and Character Fit. Three takes per script, best take advances. Retro casting-studio booth aesthetic.
